# CANDIDATE: REFINED_STRUCTURE_VETO_WITH_VOL_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a volatility filter to the existing structure veto (which blocks P-in-uptrend / C-in-downtrend) will reduce false signals in low-volatility regimes, preserving the veto's ability to remove wrong-way trades while improving edge capture on J's winner days by avoiding premature exits during volatile trends. The volatility filter ensures the veto only activates when intraday volatility is elevated, aligning with conditions where structure breaks are more meaningful.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains identical to base engine: BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON triggers fire when ≥2 of (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence) occur. The structure veto from [STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND] is retained but gated: it only blocks entries when the 5-minute ATR (average true range) exceeds its 20-period simple moving average. Exit logic unchanged (chart stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50%, runner to ribbon re-entry or 3x premium).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (based on 50% risk cap and ITM-2 strike ~$1.00 entry premium).
2. **Sample bias:** Walk-forward OOS across 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 (4 quarters) using expanding window; selection method avoids look-ahead by using only prior-bar data for volatility filter; overfit risk mitigated by requiring VolFilter to pass IS/OOS consistency gate (Sharpe ratio degradation <20%).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet executed; candidate relies on proposed mechanism).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet validated via realistic simulator; requires OPRA cache replay with bid-ask slippage model).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: sudden volatility collapse after entry (e.g., VIX flash crash) causing veto to fail to activate and expose to whipsaw; max drawdown scenario: prolonged low-vol regime where veto never fires, allowing wrong-way trades to accumulate; blow-up scenario: volatility spike during exit phase causing premature stop-out on runner leg.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (anticipate <40% based on structure veto baseline).
